name: iam_policy
description: Policy updates can grant privilege or introduce new principals.
investigate: Baseline deployment identities and correlate the policy delta before escalation.

name: service_key
description: New user-managed keys can provide durable access.
investigate: Allowlist documented exceptions and prefer workload identity.

name: sink
description: Changing routing can hide future activity from security monitoring.
investigate: Review the destination and filter diff against change tickets.

name: firewall
description: A rule change may widen the reachable network surface.
investigate: Review source ranges, target tags and change approvals.

name: aws_role
description: A new policy attachment may expand the permissions of a role.
investigate: Compare against the AWS change record and inspect policy permissions.

name: aws_bucket
description: A policy update can broaden object access.
investigate: Inspect the new policy and block-public-access configuration.

name: failures
description: Repeated failures for one identity can indicate password guessing.
investigate: Baseline service identities and tune threshold by authentication provider.

name: spray
description: One IP failing against multiple identities can indicate password spraying.
investigate: Baseline shared egress and require more distinct users in noisy segments.

name: fail_success
description: A successful sign-in after repeated failures may indicate credential compromise.
investigate: Confirm device, MFA and source IP with the identity owner.

name: countries
description: A principal signing in from different countries rapidly may indicate account misuse.
investigate: Use known VPN ranges and managed-device context.

name: powershell
description: Encoded arguments can conceal a script payload.
investigate: Inspect the process tree and decode the payload offline.

name: office
description: A shell launched by Office can indicate malicious document execution.
investigate: Check file provenance and allowlist signed workflow tools.

name: registry
description: A Run key value can establish logon persistence.
investigate: Inspect the registry value, writing process and signer.

name: smb
description: An endpoint reaching TCP/445 can indicate remote service activity.
investigate: Baseline approved file servers and verify destination and process.

name: long_dns
description: Repeated long labels can carry encoded data.
investigate: Baseline domains and inspect entropy and query volume.

name: c2
description: Repeated permitted outbound sessions to port 4444 warrant investigation.
investigate: Inspect destinations and baseline approved services. Check periodicity separately.

name: egress
description: A single outbound session over 100 MiB can indicate bulk transfer.
investigate: Baseline traffic by source and destination. Verify whether data was authorized.

name: reads
description: A burst of object reads by one identity may precede exfiltration.
investigate: Tune to workload baselines and correlate with egress.

name: cross
description: An authentication followed by a cloud policy update can reveal abuse of a federated identity.
investigate: Match canonical identity across providers and check ticket, MFA and policy delta.
